questions.stemEn: A child has localized lower-limb pain that is worse at night and improves markedly with aspirin. An X-ray image is provided. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanationAr: night pain الذي يتحسن بوضوح مع NSAID/aspirin هو clue كلاسيكي في التجميع لـ osteoid osteoma. الصورة الأصلية مهمة.
questions.clinicalPearl: Night pain relieved by NSAIDs is a classic clue for osteoid osteoma.

questions.stemEn: An X-ray image shows a lesion recalled as having the classic appearance of osteosarcoma. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanationAr: التجميع يختار Osteosarcoma ويذكر sunburst pattern كعلامة radiographic كلاسيكية. لا يُنشر السؤال بلا الصورة الأصلية.
questions.clinicalPearl: Osteosarcoma often presents in adolescents with pain, swelling, and aggressive metaphyseal radiographic features.

questions.stemEn: A 10-year-old has progressive shoulder pain and reduced range of motion after a minor injury, without fever or weight loss. An X-ray image is provided. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanationAr: التجميع يختار osteosarcoma اعتمادًا على الـX-ray والصورة السريرية، لكن الصورة هي المفتاح الأساسي ويجب استعادتها قبل النشر.
questions.clinicalPearl: Bone tumor pain may first be attributed to sports injury; persistent progressive pain warrants imaging review.

questions.stemEn: A bone X-ray image shows findings recalled as Ewing sarcoma. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanationAr: التجميع يذكر lytic lesion مع periosteal reaction وonion-skinning كعلامات مناسبة لـ Ewing sarcoma. الصورة الأصلية مطلوبة.
questions.clinicalPearl: Ewing sarcoma can mimic osteomyelitis and may have systemic symptoms.

tts.text: A bone X-ray image shows findings suggestive of Ewing sarcoma. What is the most likely diagnosis?

questions.stemEn: An X-ray image is recalled as showing Ewing sarcoma. What is the next appropriate action?
questions.explanationAr: التجميع يختار referral to oncology center. لأن السؤال image-based يجب ربط صورة الـX-ray الأصلية.
questions.clinicalPearl: Suspected malignant bone tumor requires urgent specialist oncology/orthopedic oncology evaluation.

questions.stemEn: A 10-year-old has three months of localized hip pain, normal examination and laboratory tests, no fever, and an X-ray showing a lytic lesion near the sacroiliac region. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanationAr: التجميع يختار CRMO/CNO بسبب chronic sterile bone pain مع normal labs وعدم وجود systemic illness، لكن الصورة ومكان الآفة يجب مراجعتهما.
questions.clinicalPearl: CNO/CRMO causes chronic sterile inflammatory bone pain and can involve the pelvis.

questions.stemEn: A 2-year-old with constipation is found to have a paraspinal mass. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanationAr: paraspinal mass مع constipation بسبب mass effect يتماشى في التجميع مع neuroblastoma.
questions.clinicalPearl: Neuroblastoma may arise paraspinally and cause bowel, bladder, or spinal cord symptoms.

questions.stemEn: A 5-year-old who was previously toilet trained develops enuresis and soiling. Spine CT shows a mass compressing the spinal cord. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanationAr: new bowel/bladder dysfunction مع spinal cord compression في طفل يتماشى في التجميع مع paraspinal neuroblastoma.
questions.clinicalPearl: Neuroblastoma can extend through neural foramina and compress the spinal cord.

questions.stemEn: A child has irritability and an enlarging abdominal mass over one month, with tenderness on examination but stable vital signs. What is the most likely diagnosis among the recalled options?
questions.explanationAr: التجميع يضع Neuroblastoma لكنه يذكر صراحة أن tenderness غير نوعية وأن جميع الخيارات قد تظهر ككتلة غير مؤلمة عادةً. السؤال غير كافٍ للتمييز دون hints إضافية.
questions.clinicalPearl: An abdominal mass question needs location, crossing midline, hypertension, hematuria, catecholamine clues, or other discriminators.

questions.stemEn: An adolescent with abdominal lymphoma develops vomiting, abdominal pain and generalized tenderness two weeks after radiotherapy. X-rays show dilated loops with air-fluid levels. Which diagnosis was recalled as most likely?
questions.explanationAr: الملف نفسه يضع علامة استفهام على Intestinal pseudo-obstruction ويذكر أن radiation enteropathy قد تسبب bowel obstruction عبر inflammation, fibrosis, adhesions أو dysmotility. لا نثبت C قبل التحقق.
questions.clinicalPearl: Post-radiation bowel obstruction requires careful distinction between mechanical obstruction and dysmotility/pseudo-obstruction.
